# rms_alert_configuration (Resource)

Manages a Teltonika RMS Alert Configuration for device monitoring alerts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rms_alert_configuration" "main" {
  device_id        = 789012345
  alert_type_id    = 1
  alert_subtype_id = 2
  action           = 1
  subject          = "Device Alert"
  message          = "Alert from device"
  email            = "admin@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alert_type_id` (Number) The alert type ID.
- `device_id` (Number) The ID of the device to monitor.

### Optional

- `action` (Number) Alert action (1=email, 2=sms, 3=webhook).
- `alert_subtype_id` (Number) The alert subtype ID.
- `data_limit` (Number) Data limit interval in minutes.
- `delivery_retry` (Boolean) Whether delivery retry is enabled.
- `email` (String) Email address for notifications.
- `message` (String) Message content for alerts.
- `redundancy_interval` (Number) Redundancy interval in minutes.
- `retry_count` (Number) Number of retries.
- `retry_interval` (Number) Retry interval in minutes.
- `sim` (Number) SIM card number (1 or 2).
- `smtp_config_id` (Number) SMTP configuration ID for sending emails.
- `subject` (String) Subject line for email alerts.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for the alert configuration.
